# t17 — Current-tree layered architecture re-certification

## Verdict

**PASS — 0 CRITICAL / 0 HIGH.**

The current working tree now satisfies the eight-item t17 certification contract. The four former
HIGH findings and one LOW finding are closed, the current bytecode graph is complete and acyclic,
all port directions are correct, and the full Java 28 build plus direct shaded-JAR startup pass.

This is a fresh ruling over the post-t17.1/t17.2 tree. It does not inherit the backend tasks'
conclusions:

- the production source, generated bytecode, rule subject sets, DI graph, and package graph were
  independently inspected;
- all four repaired controls were independently driven RED in an isolated copy and restored GREEN;
- the full build and CLI startup were re-executed from the current tree.

## Current Responsibility Split

| Boundary | Current owner | Verified responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| Process entry | root `ReviewApp` | Prepare host, start/close Micronaut, resolve one presentation entry component, propagate exit status |
| Inbound bindings | root `ApplicationPortFactory`, `ReviewPortFactory` | Join inbound interfaces to application use cases using already-created ports and plain values |
| CLI | `presentation.CliApplication` and command/formatter/parser collaborators | Global options, help/version, command selection, dispatch, output, and exit-code policy |
| Use cases | `application.*` | Application orchestration and policy; no framework or adapter dependency |
| Boundary contracts | `application.port.inbound` / `outbound` | Framework-free inbound and outbound interfaces/DTOs |
| Host/SDK/config/files | focused `infrastructure.*` adapters/factories | External I/O, settings mapping, Copilot SDK construction, filesystem output, logging, and startup hardening |
| Business values/rules | `domain.*` | JDK, domain, and shared dependencies only |
| Cross-layer pure helpers | `shared` | JDK dependencies only |

Root source inspection found no filesystem, Copilot SDK, Logback, or configuration-mapping
operations in either factory after comments were excluded. `ReviewApp` contains no direct
filesystem or console-output operation.

## Port Direction and Runtime DI

- **Inbound:** 8 interfaces, 8 direct implementers, all under `application`.
- **Outbound:** 14 interfaces, 15 direct implementers, all under `infrastructure`
  (`RunCopilotSessionPort` intentionally has two infrastructure implementations).
- `RunReviewPort` has one direct implementation:
  `application.review.ReviewOrchestrator`.
- `ReviewPortFactory.java:21-37` constructs that application implementation from outbound ports.
- `ApplicationPortSplitWiringTest` proves the split inbound and outbound graphs resolve from a real
  Micronaut CLI context.
- `PortDirectionWiringTest` additionally pins token, skill, review settings/session, and
  `RunReviewPort` concrete bindings and behavior.

### ADR-0006 deviation reconciliation

| Deviation | Current ruling |
|---|---|
| #1 infrastructure-owned `ResolveTokenPort` | Resolved: application `ResolveTokenUseCase`; infrastructure owns outbound token acquisition |
| #2 wrong/dual `ExecuteSkillPort` implementation | Resolved: application `ExecuteSkillUseCase` is the implementation and DI binding |
| #3 Rule 4 admitted all ports | Resolved: only `application.port.outbound` is allowed |
| #4 monolithic exempt `ApplicationPortFactory` | Resolved: responsibility split, wiring-only root factory, Rule 4 at 0/0, real-context binding test |
| #8 infrastructure-owned `RunReviewPort` | Resolved: application `ReviewOrchestrator`, root binding, split outbound session/settings adapters |

ADR-0006 deviation #5 (partial `java.util.logging`) remains explicitly **Partial** and outside the
t17 dependency-direction scope; it is not reclassified here.

## Ten Original Cycle Reconciliation

| t2 cycle | Current breaking mechanism | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1. `agent <-> report.core` | `AgentConfig` and `ReviewResult` are domain values; old packages are absent | Removed |
| 2. `agent <-> service` | `TemplateService` is absent; application accesses templates through outbound `LoadTemplatePort` | Removed |
| 3. `agent <-> skill` | Agent/skill values are domain-owned and circuit-breaker policy is no longer an agent utility | Removed |
| 4. `agent <-> util` | Old `util` is absent; pure helpers are in `shared`, external helpers in `infrastructure` | Removed |
| 5. `service <-> orchestrator` | Old service/orchestrator packages are absent; application orchestrates through outbound ports | Removed |
| 6. `report.core <-> report.formatter` | Report values and pure formatters are domain-owned; application drives formatting in one direction | Removed |
| 7. `report.core <-> service` | Report orchestration uses `LoadTemplatePort`; old `ReportService` and `TemplateService` types are absent | Removed |
| 8. `report.factory <-> service` | Old `ReportGeneratorFactory` is absent; `GenerateReportUseCase` drives outbound report writing | Removed |
| 9. `report.finding <-> report.formatter` | `ReviewFinding` is a top-level value; extraction no longer calls formatting, and final formatting accepts precomputed data | Removed |
| 10. `report.summary <-> service` | Application `SummaryGenerator` uses outbound template/AI ports; `AiSummaryClient` is infrastructure-owned | Removed |

Rule 6a/6b independently confirms zero cycles in the current five-layer / 25-sibling-package graph.
Cycle 9 was also inspected at source level because co-location alone would not prove the former
class-level mutual dependency was removed.

| H3: `application.probe.T17RecertRootViolation -> ReviewPortFactory` | Rule 3a rejects layer-to-root | 20 run / exactly 1 failure; named owner and root target |
